prompts.task: Use $otel-verify to resolve a local Java agent before making any provisioning claim. Run ./service/eval/inputs/build_java_agent_fixtures.py to create candidates under ./service/.observe/eval-java-agents, then run the bundled read-only Java-agent resolver with every generated JAR as an explicit candidate and write ./service/.observe/java-agent-resolution.json. Report the exact selected path, full artifact SemVer, Premain-Class, and SHA-256 separately from production-parity status. Do not download an agent or modify application code.

judge_inputs: Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Runs the bundled resolver before declaring an agent blocker and selects the recognized upstream OpenTelemetry agent rather than trusting filename alone.
Preserves full artifact SemVer 2.1.0+build.7 and records the selected absolute path, io.opentelemetry.javaagent.OpenTelemetryAgent Premain-Class, and computed SHA-256.
Rejects the 9.0.0 malicious Premain-Class candidate and the Splunk-named wrong-family candidate even though their filenames and versions appear preferable.
Does not request that the user provide or download a pinned Java agent after local resolution succeeds.
Keeps successful verification-agent resolution separate from production parity and leaves production parity Not proven without source-derived deployment evidence.
Leaves the Spring Boot application code, dependencies, and runtime configuration unchanged.
